subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using the parts of sentences from each column of the table below. 1 5 =
stimulus: physical exercise regularly. Physical exercise be very essential for our health. It help us to be healthy and keep fit. If we don't take physical exercise regularly, we cannot perform our duties properly. So, we should keep our minds fresh too.
guide_solution: (a) Physical exercise is very essential for our health. (b) It helps us to be healthy and keep fit. (c) It helps keep our minds fresh too. (d) If we don't take physical exercise regularly, we cannot perform our duties properly. (e) So, we should take physical exercise regularly.
